title: BookMyShow
description: Developed a RESTful application with APIs for User, Movie, Reviews, Show, Show Seats, Cinema, Cinema Hall, Search, and Booking management.

Applied core design patterns including Strategy (pricing and seat selection rules), Factory (payment handling), Builder (booking life-cycle objects), and Singleton (configuration and cache managers), reducing code duplication by 30%+.

Implemented high-concurrency seat booking handling 1K+ concurrent user requests using transaction management, row-level locking, and idempotent booking flows, eliminating double booking during peak traffic.

title: SpringShield
description: Developed SpringShield, a robust Spring Security project empowered by JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for advanced authentication and authorization, securing application by 70%
Enabled method-level security coupled with role-based access control, enabling fine-grained access control over services, enhancing security posture and access management by 10x.
Automated refresh token functionality once access token expires to streamline efficient authentication, increasing performance by 15%.

title: Portfolio
description: Developed a dynamic portfolio website using React for an interactive and responsive UI.
